title: Raising the Bar: Investigating the Values of Large Language Models via Generative Evolving Testing
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures social biases and stereotypes against religious groups as part of a broader evaluation of value alignment. This includes measuring bias in conversational contexts and stereotypical agreement.
findings: The paper uses religion as one of several categories to measure social bias but does not report specific findings detailing the performance or biases of the tested LLMs with respect to religious groups. The main findings focus on the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation method, GETA, in assessing overall value conformity compared to other methods.
